findings.title: Required knowledge graph entity type is missing
findings.evidence: proj-crispr-neuro-graph has no extracted software entities.
findings.action: Add at least one reviewed software entity before publishing this graph slice.

findings.title: Entity identifier does not match the expected namespace
findings.action: Normalize the entity to DOI, ORCID, DataCite, MeSH, PubChem, UniProt, Wikidata, SWH, or GitHub form.

findings.title: Entity identifier does not match the expected namespace
findings.action: Normalize the entity to DOI, ORCID, DataCite, MeSH, PubChem, UniProt, Wikidata, SWH, or GitHub form.

findings.title: Extracted entity confidence is below threshold
findings.action: Route the entity to human review or hide it from recommendations until verified.

findings.title: Private entity lacks a project scope
findings.evidence: dataset:dataset-1 is private without a privateProjectId.
findings.action: Attach private graph nodes to a project scope or exclude them from shared graph exports.

findings.title: Relationship lacks extraction provenance
findings.evidence: edge-1 has incomplete source document or extractor metadata.
findings.action: Store source document, span, extractor version, and review state for every edge.

findings.title: Relationship has weak evidence support
findings.action: Require more evidence or mark the edge as tentative in graph navigation.

findings.title: Public relationship is derived from private content
findings.evidence: edge-1 is public but cites private source content.
findings.action: Downgrade the edge to private scope or re-extract it from public evidence.

findings.title: Relationship references a missing entity
findings.evidence: edge-2 links paper:paper-1 -> software:software-missing, but at least one endpoint is absent.
findings.action: Create the missing entity or remove the relationship before graph export.

findings.title: AI recommendation lacks enough graph evidence
findings.action: Hide or label the recommendation until enough verified graph evidence supports it.

findings.title: Public recommendation uses private user or project signals
findings.evidence: rec-1 combines private signals with public visibility.
findings.action: Keep private-signal recommendations in the user workspace only.

findings.title: Graph export format is missing or unsupported
findings.action: Choose jsonld, rdf, or graphml for downstream graph consumers.

findings.title: Public graph export lacks a license
findings.evidence: proj-crispr-neuro-graph is configured for public graph export without a license.
findings.action: Set a graph metadata license before publishing reusable linked data.

findings.title: Graph export lacks a schema version
findings.evidence: proj-crispr-neuro-graph has no schema version in exportConfig.
findings.action: Pin a schema version so downstream consumers can validate graph payloads.
